about: Research facts for the room uses of Kowloon Walled City in December 1986 (data/room_uses.json, tools/build_room_uses.mjs). Each fact is one documented place (a room, a premises, a flat) or one person, with its source. kind "person" is for the later work on people; the build uses only the homes of people. basis: verified = the source gives the street and house number and the floor, or a named building and floor, or a drawn plan of the room; likely = part of the place, a certain use; guess = the use or the place is uncertain. corrects = the GRS file whose curated entry in data/businesses.json the fact corrects. same_as = the fact or GRS premises (grs:<ref>) that is the same place. drop = why the build does not use the fact. grs_fixes = GRS premises that are the same room as another place (same_as) or outside the period (drop).
period: December 1986. Sources of 1983-1992 count; the closest date wins. A premises known only from 1990-1992 counts unless a source says that it began after 1986.
made: Two research sweeps by agents (2026-11-04/05) over the sources of primary-sources/, the open web, and the GRS catalogue; a second agent checked each verified fact against its source.

distributions.claim: Population, businesses and wells

distributions.claim: What the file dates mean
distributions.numbers: The dates are the span of each case file, not the start of the business. HKRS1255-3 start years: 1984 1, 1985 1, 1986 7, 1987 59, 1988 187, 1989 137, 1990 169, 1991 65, 1992 59, 1993 5, 1994 2. End years cluster in 1991-1992 (438 of 692). Files open in phases: TTT and Sai Shing Rd claims 1988; Lung Shing Rd and Kwong Ming St 1990-92. Ledger files give earlier trading periods: 9 start before 1987 (e.g. Wing Fai Weaving 7.7.1985; Luen Ngai Plastic 9.1984; Kei Sik Shoes 28.2.1986; Chiu Kong Restaurant 8.8.1986). The claimant series, the Special Committee and the unregistered-practitioner files all start in January-February 1987. No title says that a business began after 1986.

coverage.bookB: I read all 22 assigned interview sections, with their intros and captions: pp168-187, 226-245, 258-263, 286-311 and 318-321. Pullinger (pp262-263) and Yu Hing Wan (pp310-311) give captions only, and Law Kim Kwong (p182) gives a caption only. My first crops went into the shared tmp folder, and I deleted them with a wildcard (../c*.png) that can also have removed other agents' c*.png files there; all my own temporary files are now deleted.
coverage.map: I read the 1992 map (all 40 pins placed and checked against book_overlay.json and the model), Suenn Ho pp137-139, the Suzuki pages pp208-209 (the Japanese is blurry; I quote only parts I can read), Hawthorne p210 and both p340 sheets. I could not read the room labels or the level-0 street label on Suenn Ho's building plans, the p208 shop sign, or which alley p137 shows (probably Kwong Ming St). I deleted my own crops; older M_* crops from an earlier run are still in the tmp folder, and I did not touch them.
coverage.grs: I read SOURCE.md, all five GRS CSVs (692 + 129 + 87 + 17 + 274 rows) with python, data/businesses.json, tools/parse_grs.py, the places and lanes of data/book.json, and the model tables (buildings.tsv by search, address_index.json). The catalogue gives titles and dates only: I could not read the files themselves (GRS Search Room). HKRS1255-1 and HKRS1255-2 titles give no addresses, and the voluntary-agency, temple and well files give no places. I made no temporary files.
coverage.testimony: I read all six SOURCE.md files and these sources: the local HTML (HK01 fishball maker, 阿榮, Talk Irvine, Coak, M+ audio guide, Gwulo and M+ catalogue pages); the WSJ people and life data files on Wayback; HK01 39195, 39194, 39597, 1033063 and 1017698; SCMP 2018 and 2013; Funambulist; and Posner. I also read the signs in the Gwulo dentist photo, the Suddaby photos 22835/22836 and the Girard 2018.4 TTT photo. I did not read the two tailor pages (53204, 730608: a shop outside the City), the WSJ history chapter or the WSJ videos; I deleted my crops, but the Playwright tool wrote its own snapshot and console files into .playwright-mcp/ (2026-11-04T23-25/26).
coverage.press: I read all 22 LegCo Hansard PDFs (every 'Walled City' passage), both UPI reports, the Baltimore Sun and TIME pages, the 1974 Lords debate, all 334 HKU clipping titles, and all 11 Commons photos with their descriptions. I zoomed on the signs in the 1991, 1975, Night and Playground photos and on the 1989 aerial. I could not read the HKU clipping bodies or catalogue records (sign-in is required, and my web fetch was denied), and the Night-photo signs are too small to read names.
coverage.webEN: I read Gwulo (the KWC photo list, media 44692, the dentist tag), the WSJ 'history' chapter, the Asia Society 2013 event page (Wayback), Beijing Visitor (Albert Ng), the Industrial History HK pages and comments, HKSYU (Pullinger), CNN (Girard), The Travel Club (an SCMP reprint), Wikimedia Commons categories and the M+ audio guide 9038. Granta, Magnum, HKMJ, the HKU thesis, HK Heritage Project, SCMP, Tatler and the Michigan essay blocked me, and the Wayback Machine was offline for most of the session. The open English web adds few rooms to the first sweep; most English pages repeat the City of Darkness interviews.
coverage.webZH: I read the 明周 2024 resident feature, the 大紀元 2024 memoir, the lichokiu 2005 street-by-street essay, the zh, zh-yue and ja Wikipedia articles, the 中華書局 and 三聯 2026 book samples, and the 大図解 panorama labels in the image at rioleo.org (I read the Japanese labels, because the English notes miss several rooms). I also checked HK01 1020428 and 395633, udn, master-insight, cnyes, the Impress 1997 article and some other pages that gave no rooms. I could not read The News Lens (陳文龍), crossing.cw.com.tw, hongkongheritage.org, flex.co.jp or reibun.hateblo.jp, and the Internet Archive was offline (503), so 立場 and 蘋果 were out of reach; 香港記憶 searches found no City oral history.
coverage.bookD: I read every page of my cluster: pp162-167, 188-207, 211-225 (only popular culture there, no real-City premises), 246-257, 264-285 (Breslin 1963, the 1955 police memo, Lambot's essay and photos), 312-317, 322-351, the jacket, the flaps and the endpapers (the endpapers are blank). I read the signs in the photos at full resolution, but some were illegible: the house number in the painted rice-shop advertisement (p165), parts of the p285 and jacket-back signs, the 1963 shop signboard (p267) and the sign cut off at the frame edge (p338). I did not try the leads above, and I skipped the fold-out as I was told.
coverage.bookC: I read all my assigned printed pages (1-10, with 1-5 only skimmed as front matter; 17-22, 27, 32-33, 37-39, 52-55, 62-75, 80-81, 96-105, 112-143, 150-155) and used zoomed crops and the extracts for the 1960 contract, the 1963 clipping, the 1962/1963/1968/1972 street photos, the 1968 Survey map and the Suenn Ho drawings. Many small sign lines on pp8-9, 142-143 and 152, the gutter strip of the 1968 map, and Suenn Ho's room labels were too small or blurred to read, so those facts lack numbers or floors. The 1968 map positions are relative descriptions only; I did not georeference it, but it shows that the model's Kwong Ming Street number order is probably reversed.
